user.title: Native EZVIZ validation source
user.description: Use an existing private local-credential file and observed PES IDs. No camera is contacted during setup. Audio ID -1 explicitly omits audio. Single-lens entries remain separate; explicitly declared child lenses share one physical entry. This is a validation integration; HA and browser support remain to be tested. Optional shared relay uses an operator-managed go2rtc on IPv4 loopback. Leave API port blank for direct delivery. Relay mode permits one native acquisition per entry reload; keep preload off. Experimental relay currently fails A/V clock preservation in the tested RTSP/PyAV path; do not use for live cameras. The experimental source-clock option requires the separately patched go2rtc build; controlled offline worker passes are not live/frontend acceptance. To declare child lenses in one physical entry, enable both experimental clock and atomic relay contracts and supply its loopback API port. Child lenses activate once per acquisition; group recovery never starts a preview.

lenses.title: Declare a child lens on this physical source
lenses.description: Use only an already verified shared SDK source/profile and observed PES IDs. A stable logical lens ID (lowercase letters, digits, underscores) preserves entity identity when its display name changes. Credential revision is an opaque generation label, not a secret. No discovery or preview is performed. Each lens can activate once before whole-group Prepare; keep preload off.

data.audio_id: Observed AAC PES ID, or -1 for no audio
